CAMEL-22724.title: Camel-Keycloak: Enhance component with configurable token source priority and binding validation
CAMEL-22724.description: Add configuration options to the Keycloak component to control token source priority and enable token binding validation for more predictable and consistent behavior.

CAMEL-22693.title: camel-core - Mark up EIP and component header that are more widespread in use for tooling assistance
CAMEL-22693.description:
We should mark up component headers such as http content-type, file name, s3 bucket name, kafka topic, jms queue, sql row count, EIP split size etc which is case by case.

And then allow tooling to know, so they can show this information in summary commands and tracing. This can make it quicker for users to see what happens and understand their Camel routes and data better.
